title: Crowding Out The Noise: Algorithmic Collective Action Under Differential Privacy
reasoning: The paper is a technical investigation of the trade-off between Differential Privacy (DP) and Algorithmic Collective Action (ACA). While it discusses societal implications, fairness, and trustworthy AI as background motivation, it does not evaluate religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical reasoning frameworks. The study focus is on mathematical bounds and empirical verification using standard image and tabular datasets rather than a focus on religious or ethical evaluation.
